sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Retail of Desktop 3D Printers and Resin Filaments

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Constitutional law, customary traditional law, and statutory law incorporating common law principles; corporation statutes patterned generally on Delaware corporate law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States, as amended (2003), providing economic, trade and investment-related privileges
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus), in effect for the Republic of the Marshall Islands as a Pacific ACP Party

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act, Title 26 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, as amended; Nonresident Domestic Corporation provisions under the RMI corporate registry rules; the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012; the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit AML/CFT Guidelines; and the Registrar of Corporations' Beneficial Ownership Record-Keeping Regulations
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (non-public beneficial ownership file maintained by the registered agent and accessible to the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit and authorized regulators; no public UBO register searchable by the general public)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Name Reservation / Name Clearance Approval
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands Attorney-General's Chamber

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport and proof of identity for each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin or a licensed professional equivalent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential or business address (utility bill or bank statement) and bank or professional reference letter
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, licensed bank, attorney or certified accountant in the applicant's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization through the Republic of the Marshall Islands Embassy where the originating state is not an Apostille party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or corporate existence where the applicant is a body corporate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registry in the applicant's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization, or Hague Apostille if the home jurisdiction is an Apostille member state

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, officers, ultimate beneficial owners, signatories and material counterparties against the Marshall Islands FIU internal watchlists, the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, the US OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons list, and other applicable domestic and international sanctions lists. Enhanced due diligence is required for any politically exposed person; source of wealth and source of funds must be documented and verified. A confirmed positive match or unresolved red flag results in refusal of incorporation and filing of a suspicious transaction report with the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit. Ongoing monitoring must be conducted at least quarterly or upon a material change in the beneficial ownership profile.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations e-Registry Services Portal (administered by the Office of the Attorney-General, Republic of the Marshall Islands)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the official corporate language. Corporate names must be submitted in English/Latin script; non-Latin script names must be transliterated into Latin characters, and the registrar will compare phonetic and visual similarity when assessing availability. A foreign-language name may be accepted only with an English translation or explanation of its meaning.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 calendar days of a name rejection, the applicant may submit a written administrative appeal to the Registrar of Corporations, including a legal memorandum, corrected proposed name, and, where applicable, a written no-objection letter from the holder of an existing similar name. The Registrar will issue a final decision within 10 business days of receipt. The first administrative appeal is exempt from additional government fees; if the appeal is denied, a fresh name reservation application and fee are required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are permitted for a non-resident business corporation, provided that a licensed registered agent maintains a physical registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands for service of process. The virtual office may be used as the principal business contact address, but the registered agent must accept all legal process and official correspondence at the statutory registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low. For a low-risk non-resident online retail entity with no physical operations, unannounced physical inspection likelihood is estimated at 0.5% to 2% within the first 12 months. Official on-site inspections occur only upon credible AML/CFT risk triggers, regulator complaints, or specific intelligence; routine desk-based review and registered-agent supervision are more common.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government name search and name clearance fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation certificate fee for 30-day reservation window
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Filing of Articles of Incorporation for a non-resident Business Corporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office service for the first year
UBO KYC file setup, PEP and sanctions screening, and AML/CFT compliance support
Hague Apostille and/or consular legalization processing, translation and courier costs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Government authentication offices, translation providers, and courier service

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified notarization and English-language attestation of identity and address documents
Corporate legal review and drafting fee for pre-incorporation due diligence clearance

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (B.C.A.), Title 29, Chapter 4 of the Marshall Islands Revised Statutes, as amended; applicable Sections include 11 (Articles of Incorporation), 20 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), 34 (Initial Directors and Officers), and 38 (Organization Meeting and First Board of Directors)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Business Registry and Licensing Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro Atoll
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form AR-1) submitted under the B.C.A., with the Registrar issuing the Certificate of Incorporation as conclusive evidence of incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under the B.C.A.; the Corporation may be incorporated with zero initial capitalization and no-par value shares, and no escrow account is mandated for ordinary non-regulated trading entities; the registered agent may internally require a nominal capital attestation as a matter of policy
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the incorporator's subscription for 1,000 no-par ordinary shares at US$1.00 per share is approved, accepted, and recorded as fully paid or deferred consideration to the extent permitted under the Business Corporations Act. (2) That the registered office is established at the premier registered agent's office in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the agent's designation is ratified. (3) That the following persons are appointed officers: President, Secretary, and Treasurer, to hold office until successors are elected. (4) That the officers are authorized to execute banking, e-commerce, and regulatory filings in the Corporation's name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Business Registry and Licensing Division, Ministry of Finance, Majuro; online name reservation via the RMI Business Registry Portal or through a licensed RMI registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name availability application for a proposed corporate name ending with an accepted corporate identifier such as 'Corporation', 'Limited', or their abbreviations; simultaneously deliver the registered agent consent letter from a duly licensed RMI registered agent; pay the name reservation administrative fee; the name reservation remains valid for 90 days pending incorporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected due to conflict or similarity with an existing register entry, submit a fresh reservation request using an alternate name or file the written consent/waiver of the holder of the conflicting name to cure the objection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notarial authorities in the Republic of the Marshall Islands or any acceptable foreign notary; the licensed registered agent coordinates the execution and lodges the document with the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in strict compliance with Section 11 of the B.C.A., setting forth the corporate name, registered agent and registered office address, purpose (including e-commerce retail of desktop 3D printers, resin filaments, and consumables under ISIC 4791), authorized capital structure with no-par value shares, and the incorporator's details; the incorporator shall execute the document before a notary public and the registered agent shall countersign to evidence acceptance of appointment.
required_dossiers: Registered agent consent and acceptance letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Registrar issues a defect or query notice arising from incompleteness or inconsistency, file a corrective amendment or resubmit the Articles with a revised execution page within 14 days of the notice; no additional substantive requirements are triggered for a standard trading entity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing, Fee Settlement, and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Business Registry and Licensing Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; filings may be delivered electronically through the e-Registry portal or physically at the Majuro registry window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Transmit the executed Articles of Incorporation, registered agent consent, and cover letter to the Registrar; remit the official state filing fee of US$500 by wire transfer or authorized government depository; the Registrar examines the instrument for conformity and, upon satisfaction, issues the Certificate of Incorporation which conclusively establishes the Corporation's legal existence and juridical personality.
required_dossiers: Cover letter addressed to the Registrar of Corporations
Executed and notarized Articles of Incorporation
Proof of payment of the US$500 state filing fee
Registered agent details and contact confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for fee discrepancy or registry defect, cure by paying any shortfall or correcting the document within 30 days; where the entity has been inadvertently struck from the register, apply for restoration under the B.C.A. with the payment of restoration fees and a director's reinstatement resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of First Board Resolution, Share Issuance, and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Corporation as the internal statutory governance body
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first meeting of the board or obtain a unanimous written consent in lieu of meeting; adopt the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution approving the subscriber's share subscription, establishing the registered office, and appointing the President, Secretary, and Treasurer; issue the share certificate to the subscriber and enter the allotment in the share ledger; the officers are then authorized to open corporate bank accounts and execute e-commerce platform agreements (Stripe, Shopify Payments) and all ancillary regulatory filings.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma first board resolution as set out in the incorporation_legal_framework
Share certificate and share register ledger
Officer consent forms and identity documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any defect in the written consent, such as an officer's refusal to accept appointment, is cured by executing a replacement resolution appointing another qualified individual; a majority of directors may ratify a defective written action retroactively in accordance with the B.C.A.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Statutory Register and Annual Standing Maintenance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent acting under the supervision of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the initial non-resident registration statement or domestic business registry notification as applicable, update the registered agent's statutory registers with the final registered office details, and schedule the first annual corporate franchise tax statement for filing through the registered agent to ensure the Corporation remains in good standing, exempt from local taxation in the Tax Exempt Zone, and eligible for certificates of good standing on demand.
required_dossiers: First-year annual corporate franchise tax statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A late annual filing is cured by paying the applicable late fee and filing the overdue statement; if the Corporation is involuntarily dissolved for non-compliance, the board must adopt a reinstatement resolution and file a reinstatement application with the Registrar together with all outstanding fees and filing documents.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board mandate applies to a non-resident business corporation conducting online retail of 3D printers and consumables; conditionally, the Ministry of Commerce and Trade, Trade License Division, would issue a local trade license only if a physical branch or warehouse in the Republic of the Marshall Islands is established
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required for cross-border online retail of desktop 3D printers and resin filaments; conditionally, a Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) under the Foreign Investment Business Act 2006 would be required if the Corporation conducts any physical commercial activity within the Republic of the Marshall Islands

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from a Full EIA Report; registration-only under the RMI Environmental Protection Act 1984 for pure retail, e-commerce, and low-impact warehousing activities; a Full EIA Report is triggered solely if the operation expands into solvent resin reprocessing, filament extrusion, additive manufacturing production, or hazardous waste recycling at an industrial scale
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with EPA effluent discharge standards under the RMI Environmental Regulations; zero point-source wastewater discharge from warehousing operations; volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions kept below the EPA de minimis threshold of 0.5 tons per year; waste resin cartridges and unused filaments classified as commercial non-hazardous waste unless contaminated, in which case EPA-approved waste manifests, container labeling, and disposal protocols apply

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not mandated for a purely virtual e-commerce operation; if a physical Majuro warehouse or office is opened, the Corporation would require a Fire Safety Certification from the RMI Fire Protection Authority, structural load inspections for racking and storage mezzanines, and a workplace clearance certificate from the RMI Occupational Safety and Health office covering electrical safety, chemical storage of resins, and emergency egress procedures

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Tax Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; no dedicated national e-filing portal (paper or local agent submission via Ministry of Finance / RMI consulate)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation not deriving RMI-source gross revenue is not subject to income tax or Business Privilege Tax and is not required to obtain a local tax identification number. If the entity later establishes a physical place of business or makes on-island sales, it must file a BPT registration with the Revenue and Tax Division, obtain a Marshall Islands Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN), and comply with social security and wage withholding obligations. For customs importation of 3D printers and filaments, the entity must register as an importer with the Customs Division and may use the BPT TIN as the customs reference number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections are available in Marshall Islands law; non-resident Business Corporations are categorically outside gross receipts tax jurisdiction unless they engage in a trade or business in the Republic, in which case the Business Privilege Tax Act applies without elective classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST/Sales-and-Use tax; indirect fiscal levies are limited to customs import duties and the territorial Business Privilege Tax on RMI-source gross revenue
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable to a non-resident BC with no RMI nexus. Where on-island business is undertaken, BPT registration is required immediately upon commencement of business activity; no minimum revenue threshold exempts a non-resident corporation from registration, although a small-scale domestic operator may qualify for a negligible-revenue administrative tolerance (de minimis) not codified in the Business Privilege Tax Act.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or continuous transaction control requirements exist in the Marshall Islands. Imported paper invoices and ordinary shipping documents are acceptable for customs and BPT compliance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: There is no export VAT zero-rating regime because the Marshall Islands does not impose VAT/GST. Sales of 3D printers and consumables by a non-resident BC to customers outside the Republic are outside the territorial scope of BPT; accordingly, no BPT is charged and no refund mechanism is needed. Export shipments from Marshall Islands waters are free from export duties and are not subject to any domestic substantive tax.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Foreign Purchase Order or Commercial Invoice
Banking evidence of inbound payment (inward remittance certificate) for export proceeds
Certificate of Non-Exceptional Cargo (if requested by the RMI Customs Division)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Although no export zero-rating credit is claimable, fraudulent misdescription of exports to evade import duties or BPT can result in civil penalties up to 200% of the tax or duty evaded, interest accrual at the statutory RMI rate, arrest of ships/cargo, and criminal fines plus imprisonment for willful evasion; retrospective assessment is not time-barred under the civil fraud exception.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI): no indigenous central bank and no dedicated foreign exchange administration exists. The RMI is a US-dollarised jurisdiction under the Compact of Free Association; the United States Federal Reserve System is the de facto anchor of monetary and clearing infrastructure. Bank licensing and prudential supervision are discharged by the Office of the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance & Investment, RMI, under the Banking Act 2000 (as amended).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility: the RMI imposes no capital-account or current-account exchange controls, no repatriation licensing, and no withholding friction on dividends, share redemptions, interest, or director fees. USD is the sole legal tender, so no domestic-currency conversion step exists; profits may be remitted offshore without central-bank approval. The only practical convertibility constraint is the OFAC sanctions screening and AML risk appetite of upstream correspondent banks (typically US or Guam), not RMI law.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. RMI statutes impose no statutory timeline, mandatory conversion ratio, or surrender obligation for export proceeds. E-commerce receipts from desktop 3D printers, resin filaments, and consumables may be retained 100% in USD in the corporate account, swept offshore, or otherwise deployed at the BC's discretion without any foreign-exchange filing.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Marshall Islands, Inc. (BMI) - Majuro
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operational/Current Account; domestic clearing only; no treasury sweep product for non-resident entities

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam - RMI Branch, Majuro (US-chartered, FDIC-regulated; subject to US OFAC, CIP, and Bank Secrecy Act framework)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Commercial Operating Account with US Fedwire/CHIPS correspondent clearing

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Direct onboarding rating: Low; indirect onboarding via a supported-market payment vehicle: High. Stripe and Shopify Payments do not accept an RMI-registered entity as a settlement merchant, so the treasury blueprint requires a supported-jurisdiction merchant-of-record, preferably a 100% owned US Delaware LLC with the RMI BC as sole member. Leading fintech EMIs and neobanks (Airwallex, Payoneer, Wise Business, Currenxie) generally exclude RMI from their corporate-supported lists and typically demand a US address plus US EIN. Legal constraints: RMI law does not prohibit the BC from owning a foreign LLC, and no exchange-control approval is required for the downstream dividend or loan upstream. Recommended stack: US merchant LLC (Stripe/Shopify settlement) -> USD concentration account at Bank of Guam RMI Branch -> SWIFT MT103 outbound payments to 3D printer and filament suppliers.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Not statutorily mandatory: the RMI Banking Act 2000 does not require directors to appear physically. In practice, RMI-licensed banks require either an in-person visit to the Majuro branch or a bank-approved video interview with all directors and UBOs, supported by apostilled corporate records and notarised identification; remote opening is permissible but discretionary. For the US fintech/LLC leg, no physical presence is required: a certified ownership chain, EIN assignment letter, and notarised KYC pack are sufficient. Recommendation: schedule one board-kickoff trip to Majuro or Guam to establish officer rapport and accelerate final approval.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident-owned RMI Business Corporation with no local office or employees, triggering the 'offshore shell' typology at correspondent and fintech underwriting stages.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled Certificate of Incorporation and Articles of Incorporation; current Certificate of Good Standing from the RMI Registrar; Registered Agent and Registered Office certificate; Register of Directors, Officers, and Shareholders; notarised passports of all UBOs; certified board resolution opening the account and naming signatories; signed source-of-funds and source-of-wealth declaration; two bank/professional reference letters; e-commerce business plan including live Shopify store URL.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: RMI's maritime/shipping association: many RMI entities are ship-owning or vessel-management companies, which may cause a 3D-printer e-commerce merchant to be misclassified as a higher-risk shipping account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISIC 4791 scope evidence: company extract stating online retail of desktop 3D printers, resin filaments and consumables; active storefront terms of service and SSL certificate; Shopify/Stripe settlement statements; commercial import invoices for printers and filaments; signed declaration of non-involvement in shipping, petroleum, defence contracting, gaming, or crypto.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Geographical mismatch: registered office in Majuro but operating and sourcing management in Hong Kong or Shenzhen, raising a conduit or front-company suspicion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supply-chain pack: master supply agreements with filament and 3D-printer manufacturers; third-party logistics (3PL) warehouse or fulfilment-centre contract; management services agreement with the Hong Kong/Shenzhen operating office; office lease or co-working agreement; import customs declarations and bill-of-lading samples matching purchase orders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume aggregated deposits arriving from Stripe/Shopify as PSP settlements rather than consumer-labelled individual payments, potentially flagged as a money-mule transaction pattern.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Payment-processor settlement ledger extracted from Stripe/Shopify and reconciled in aggregate to bank statements; sample customer order invoices; refund and chargeback policy with records; annual compliance certificate; completed AML/CTF risk assessment confirming the Low_Risk_Standard e-commerce profile.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Wire protocol: investor issues SWIFT MT103 to the BC's USD account at Bank of Guam RMI Branch or an approved US correspondent. Field 50K: remitter legal name and address; Field 59: exact RMI BC legal name and account number; Field 70: 'Equity injection per Board Resolution No. __ of [date]'; Field 72: '/RECIPIENT/' with 'NO LOAN' disambiguator. Purpose-code mapping: because RMI publishes no domestic BOP codes, use IMF BPM6 category 'Equity and investment fund shares' or the bank's proprietary code 'F-Equity'; for the US clearing chain designate 'Investment' in the OFAC/Treasury compliance mapping. Verification pack: certified shareholders' resolution approving the subscription; updated Register of Members; apostilled incorporation certificate; Certificate of Good Standing; UBO passport and source-of-funds affidavit; board-authorized signatory list. Remittances above USD 50,000 should be pre-notified to the relationship manager; cash-equivalent deposits above USD 10,000 may trigger FinCEN reporting only at the US correspondent level, and the BC must retain records for six years.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Standard rail: SWIFT MT103 via the RMI branch or its US correspondent; there is no domestic RTGS, so USD clearing is executed over Fedwire/CHIPS with T+0/T+1 value dating. Invoices under USD 50,000: plain MT103. Procurement of 3D printers, resin filaments, and packaging from China or the EU: irrevocable documentary letters of credit issued under ICC UCP600, with advising bank in the supplier's jurisdiction; intra-Asia consignments may use URC522 documentary collections. E-commerce refunds, chargebacks, and PSP settlement reversals are handled through the Stripe/Shopify rails at the merchant-of-record LLC and reconciled to the RMI BC. Every outgoing payment must map to a purchase order and customs/BL evidence to preserve the Low_Risk_Standard AML classification.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Offshore USD/CNH non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with a Hong Kong or Singapore investment-grade bank; no RMI licensing barrier exists.
USD/CNY deliverable forwards or FX swaps via a bank with onshore CNY delivery capability, hedging forecast 3D-printer and filament import purchases.
USD/EUR deliverable forwards for EU-origin resin and consumables suppliers.
Cross-currency swaps (USD/CNH and USD/EUR) for multi-year framework supply agreements, designated as hedging instruments under the BC's board-approved treasury policy.
Vanilla USD/CNH or USD/EUR options to cap supplier-cost inflation.
All derivatives are bookable offshore (Hong Kong, Singapore, New York); no onshore RMI derivatives market exists, and RMI law imposes no capital-control restriction on these transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Franchise Tax Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the last day of the month in which the anniversary of incorporation occurs; renewal must be submitted via the registered agent before the anniversary month ends.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 200; failure to file for 90 days after the due date permits the Registrar to administratively dissolve or strike off the corporation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit required for non-resident Business Corporations; audit is triggered only for entities listed on a recognized stock exchange, upon written request of shareholders holding at least 10% of issued shares, or by specific order of the Registrar.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or US GAAP as adopted by the board; no mandatory statutory framework for tax-exempt non-resident entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate UBO filing is submitted to the Registrar; the registered agent must maintain an internal beneficial ownership register and obtain written confirmation of ownership from each shareholder at least annually. Any transfer of shares must be reflected in the register of members and confirmed with the agent before the next anniversary.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - USD 8,000 (only if triggered or voluntarily requested)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Not applicable. The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) levies no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, gross revenue tax on non-resident earnings, or payroll tax on a Non-Resident Business Corporation. Taxation under the Income Tax Act 1989 attaches only to income derived from sources within the RMI; a non-resident domestic corporation conducting all e-commerce operations outside the RMI has zero domestic tax exposure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Business Corporations Act 1990, Section 74 — Annual Corporate Report; filed electronically with the RMI Registrar of Corporations via the official online registry portal (www.register-iri.com). No corporate income tax return is prescribed; the annual report doubles as the sole periodic compliance filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation. The report must state the fiscal-year-end and be accompanied by payment of the annual government fee; a filing submitted after the anniversary date is subject to default penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact corporate name and registration number of the Business Corporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the name exactly as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; no trade names or DBA suffixes unless separately registered.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and full address of the licensed registered agent in the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident BC must retain a qualified RMI registered agent; the agent's consent for the reporting year must be maintained on record.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in the Marshall Islands (physical street address, not a P.O. Box).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This may be the registered agent's office address; it is treated as the sole legal service address for all RMI governmental correspondence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of all directors and officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident individuals may serve; no RMI residency requirement for directors of a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation, but the register of directors must be accurate as of the filing date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year-end date adopted for the corporation's accounting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any date may be selected; if different from the anniversary date, the e-commerce operator should reconcile this date with home-country reporting to avoid duplicate active periods.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, classes of shares, and number of shares issued and outstanding.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report in U.S. dollars; disclosure of beneficial ownership is not required on the annual report itself but must be available to the registered agent under the RMI Beneficial Ownership Regulations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-Resident Status Declaration confirming the corporation's offshore commercial activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be affirmed annually; the declaration underpins the statutory exemption from the RMI Business License Tax and confirms that no business is transacted within RMI territory.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a default penalty equal to the annual report fee. If the report remains unfiled for 90 days after the anniversary date, the Registrar may administratively dissolve the corporation and strike it from the active registry; continued operation after dissolution exposes directors and officers to personal liability for transactions in the corporation's name.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) network. Because no domestic withholding tax is imposed on dividends paid by a Marshall Islands Business Corporation, treaty relief is unnecessary for the corporation. A foreign shareholder seeking a foreign tax credit in its residence jurisdiction should obtain from the RMI Registrar, via its registered agent, a Certificate of Non-Resident Status or a letter of tax-residency confirmation evidencing the corporation's zero domestic tax liability; the certificate is submitted to the foreign tax authority as supporting documentation for the dividend's tax-exempt character.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% domestic withholding rate on outbound royalties and interest paid by an RMI Business Corporation to non-resident recipients. No treaty rates apply because no DTA network exists; the zero-rate regime is absolute. Lenders and IP licensors should nonetheless confirm that the underlying financing and IP ownership arrangements are commercially substantive to avoid characterization as notional or sham transactions by foreign revenue authorities.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable in U.S. dollars. The RMI has no codified transfer pricing documentation thresholds, no Local File or Master File obligations, and no annual TP return. Arm's-length pricing only becomes indirectly relevant where an entity carries on an Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) 'relevant activity'; in such cases, contemporaneous records demonstrating arm's-length outcomes for inter-group transactions must be maintained and produced to the RMI Competent Authority on demand.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP — Comparable Uncontrolled Price Method: preferred for benchmarked online retail goods pricing where comparable market transactions for 3D printers and resin filaments exist.
Resale Price Method: appropriate for a distribution-first e-commerce structure where goods are purchased from group affiliates and resold to end consumers.
Cost Plus Method: suitable for light-touch logistics and fulfillment services rendered by the RMI entity to foreign group members.
TNMM — Transactional Net Margin Method: the default fallback where benchmarking data for gross-margin methods is insufficient.
Profit Split Method: reserved for integrated operations that combine e-commerce platform functionality, brand intangibles, and customer data in a single intra-group value chain.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations Act 2019 (as amended) requires relevant entities to demonstrate adequate substance in the RMI proportionate to their relevant activities. An online retailer of desktop 3D printers and consumables is in scope only if it qualifies as a 'distribution and service centre business', i.e., it purchases goods from, or provides services to, a non-resident group entity. A direct-to-consumer marketplace operator buying from third-party suppliers and selling to independent customers generally falls outside the statutory list of relevant activities; nevertheless, the entity must file annual ESR notification and, where in scope, an ESR return identifying its activity status, and must satisfy the reduced substance test (directed and managed in the RMI, adequate employees, premises, and expenditure) if the activity is fully within RMI scope.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the RMI Business Corporation as a nominee to receive online retail profits generated from the beneficial owner's local customer base while failing to declare the income and the foreign corporate vehicle to the domestic revenue authority.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The RMI will cooperate through Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs), the Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance, and automatic beneficial-ownership exchange; it levies no domestic penalty itself, but the owner's home jurisdiction may impose criminal tax-evasion penalties of up to 75% of understated tax plus civil fraud penalties, and imprisonment of 5 to 10 years for willful evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who knowingly sign or approve false non-resident declarations or disguised dividend flows can be joined as defendants in foreign civil restitution actions, subjected to travel bans by home-country courts, and extradited where the evasion offense constitutes an extraditable crime.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the BC as a hollow vehicle with no business function, no local office, and no substantive operations while simultaneously claiming ESR-relevant distribution activity, or misdeclaring the entity's ESR status on the annual notification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Economic Substance Regulations, a non-compliant relevant entity faces a financial penalty of up to US$10,000 and a continuing penalty of up to US$1,000 per day of default; false ESR declarations constitute a criminal offense. The RMI may also be listed as a non-cooperative jurisdiction by the EU and OECD, triggering defensive countermeasures against the group's broader commercial operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers who knowingly submit false ESR notifications or substance statements commit an offense punishable by imprisonment of up to 12 months and a fine; directors may be disqualified from serving in other RMI entities and held personally liable for penalties if the entity is insolvent.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Annual Report and Pay Annual Fee
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Non-filing of the BCA Section 74 annual report and non-payment of the annual government fee by the anniversary date, or continued trading after dissolution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A default penalty equal to the annual fee is assessed immediately; after 90 days of continuing default, the Registrar administratively dissolves the corporation and revokes its Charter, and the corporation's rights to title and assets vest in its directors as statutory trustees. Any contract entered into after dissolution is voidable against the corporation but enforceable personally against the persons who purported to act on its behalf.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, officers, and shareholders who transact business after dissolution are jointly and severally liable for the corporation's debts and obligations incurred during that period; creditors may pierce the corporate veil without the usual alter-ego showing because the statutory corporate existence had already ceased.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing U.S. and EU customer payments through Stripe or Shopify Payments without maintaining an adequate beneficial-ownership register, or completing online sales of controlled 3D-printing equipment, resins, or technical data to persons in comprehensively sanctioned countries.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under RMI AML/CFT law, failure to maintain beneficial-ownership records and to conduct customer due diligence carries fines of up to US$250,000, imprisonment of up to 10 years for directors found to be wilfully blind, and revocation of the registered agent mandate. Separately, the U.S. Treasury OFAC imposes civil penalties up to US$250,000 per violation or twice the value of the transaction for any person facilitating sanctioned trade through U.S. payment rails; criminal liability for sanctions-evasion schemes reaches 20 years of imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Beneficial owners exercising direct control over the payment gateway are treated as separate persons by OFAC and can be sanctioned personally; RMI-registered directors who sign suspicious transaction reports or authorize payouts to sanctioned parties face extradition requests, personal asset freezes, and permanent travel bans from allied jurisdictions.
